extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the browser and in the store. A brand name: keep it as is.

extensionDescription.message: Save all the tabs of a window to a file, close it, and get it back later with a double-click.
extensionDescription.description: Short description shown in the browser and in the store. 132 characters at most.

actionTitle.message: Save this window with Keep Tabs
actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the extension icon in the toolbar.

languageCode.description: Code of the language of this file ("en", "fr"…). Not a sentence: write the code of the language you translate into.

windowTabCount_one.description: Popup, under the title, when the window has one tab (singular form).

windowTabCount_other.description: Popup, under the title: number of tabs in the window (plural form).

fileNameTab_one.description: Word after the tab count in the default file name, e.g. KeepTabs_1-tab_2026-11-02_14-35-08 (singular). One word, no spaces, no accents if possible.

fileNameTab_other.description: Word after the tab count in the default file name, e.g. KeepTabs_8-tabs_2026-11-02_14-35-08 (plural). One word, no spaces, no accents if possible.

fileNameLabel.description: Popup: label of the file name field.

lazyLoadingLabel.message: Load tabs only when I open them
lazyLoadingLabel.description: Popup: label of the switch that restores tabs without loading them.

lazyLoadingHint.message: Only the active tab loads right away, so restoring is faster.
lazyLoadingHint.description: Popup: explanation under the lazy loading switch.

saveButton.description: Popup: button that opens the "Save as" dialog.

savingButton.description: Popup: label of the save button while the file is being written, which can take a few seconds.

fileTypeDescription.description: Type of file shown in the "Save as" dialog.

savedMessage.description: Popup: confirmation once the file is written.

closeWindowButton.description: Popup: button shown after saving, closes the saved window.

closeWindowFailed.message: The window could not be closed: $ERROR$
closeWindowFailed.description: Popup: error when closing the saved window fails.

notHtmlWarning.message: This file does not end in .html: double-clicking it may not open it in your browser, so the window would not be restored.
notHtmlWarning.description: Popup: warning after saving, when the user typed another extension in the "Save as" dialog. Keep ".html" as is.

saveFailed.message: The file could not be saved: $ERROR$
saveFailed.description: Popup: error when writing the file fails.

readFailed.message: Keep Tabs could not read this window: $ERROR$
readFailed.description: Popup: error when the tabs of the window cannot be read.

incognitoNotSupported.message: Private windows cannot be saved with Keep Tabs.

localFilesWarning_one.message: $COUNT$ tab shows a file from your computer. It will be saved, but it will only reopen automatically if you turn on “Allow access to file URLs”.
localFilesWarning_one.description: Popup warning (singular form). Use the exact name of the setting shown in the browser's extension details, in your language.

localFilesWarning_other.message: $COUNT$ tabs show files from your computer. They will be saved, but they will only reopen automatically if you turn on “Allow access to file URLs”.
localFilesWarning_other.description: Popup warning (plural form). Use the exact name of the setting shown in the browser's extension details, in your language.

openSettingsButton.description: Popup: opens the extension's details, where file URL access is turned on.

openSettingsFailed.message: The setting could not be opened: $ERROR$
openSettingsFailed.description: Popup: error when opening the extension's details fails.

unrestorableWarning_one.message: $COUNT$ tab cannot be reopened automatically, for example because its content was temporary:
unrestorableWarning_one.description: Popup warning (singular form), followed by the title of the tab.

unrestorableWarning_other.message: $COUNT$ tabs cannot be reopened automatically, for example because their content was temporary:
unrestorableWarning_other.description: Popup warning (plural form), followed by the titles of the tabs.

untitledTab.description: Popup: shown in the warning list for a tab that has neither a title nor an address.

sessionSummary_one.description: Session file, under its title (singular form).

sessionSummary_other.description: Session file, under its title (plural form).

sessionNotInstalled.message: To reopen these tabs automatically, in a window identical to the saved one, install the Keep Tabs extension and open this file again.
sessionNotInstalled.description: Session file: message shown when Keep Tabs is not installed.

sessionRestoring.description: Session file: shown while Keep Tabs restores the window.

sessionPinned.description: Session file: badge in front of a pinned tab.
